records.title: Cocktails
records.instrumentation: sheet-music series/grouping; linked transcriptions for two pianos
records.contents: 1. Miss Annabelle Lee (jazz) (comp. Sidney Cläre, Lew Pollack, Harry Richman); 2. Raquel (waltz) (comp. Jesse Greer); 3. One Step to Heaven (foxtrot) (comp. Jesse Greer); 4. Sunshine (slow-fox) (comp. Irving Berlin); 5. Austrian Coctail (foxtrot transcription on famous Strauss melodies); 6. Get Out and Get under the Moon (foxtrot) (comp. L. Shay); 7. Sonny Boy (comp. Ray Henderson, Buddy DeSylva, and Lew Brown); 8. Russian Coctail (foxtrot transcription on celebrated Tschaikowsky melodies); 9. The Wedding of the Painted Doll (foxtrot); 10. Pagan Love Song: Singin' in the rain
records.publicNote: Cocktails is a collection/parent record for 11 linked sheet-music entries. The cover explicitly states “Transcriptions by Dr. B. Kaper.”

records.title: Jazz Drops
records.instrumentation: transcriptions for piano
records.contents: 1. The Wedding of the Painted Doll (comp. N. H. Brown); 2. Ain't Misbehavin' (comp. Harry Brooks, Thomas Waller); 3. Drei Musketiere (comp. H. Riesenfeld, R. Benatzky); 4. Singin' in the Rain (comp. N. H. Brown); 5. How am I to Know (comp. Jack King); 6. Swingin' in a Hammock (comp. P. Wendling); 7. I'm Yours (comp. John W. Green); 8. Cuban Love Song
records.publicNote: StabiKat records held volume nos. 1–5 as Berlin: Alberti, 1930–31, shelfmark DMS 266613; Hofmeister independently lists individual numbers in 1930 and 1931.
